mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT i.inspection_id AS inspectionId, i.submitted_at AS submittedAt, i.result AS result, i.facility_id AS facilityId, f.domain AS domain, f.name AS facilityName, f.floor AS floor, f.zone AS zone, i.inspector_id AS inspectorId, ip.name AS inspectorName FROM inspections i JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = i.facility_id LEFT JOIN inspector_profile ip ON ip.inspector_id = i.inspector_id WHERE f.managers_id = #{managerId} ORDER BY i.submitted_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT i.INSPECTION_ID AS inspectionId, i.SUBMITTED_AT AS submittedAt, f.NAME AS facilityName, f.FLOOR AS facilityFloor, f.ZONE AS facilityZone, ip.NAME AS inspectorName, ip.PHONE AS inspectorPhone FROM INSPECTIONS i JOIN FACILITIES f ON f.FACILITY_ID = i.FACILITY_ID LEFT JOIN INSPECTOR_PROFILE ip ON ip.INSPECTOR_ID = i.INSPECTOR_ID WHERE i.INSPECTION_ID = #{inspectionId} AND f.MANAGERS_ID = #{managerId}

SELECT ci.ITEM_ID AS item_id, ci.LABEL AS label, ci.TYPE AS type, ci.ORDER_NO AS order_no, iir.RESULT_ID AS result_id, CASE ci.TYPE WHEN 'BOOL' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(iir.VALUE_BOOL), 'N') IN ('Y','1','T') THEN '예' ELSE '아니오' END WHEN 'NUM' THEN TO_CHAR(iir.VALUE_NUM) WHEN 'TEXT' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(iir.VALUE_TEXT, 4000, 1) END AS answer_text, CASE WHEN ci.TYPE = 'BOOL' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(iir.VALUE_BOOL), 'N') IN ('N','0','F') THEN '이상' ELSE '완료' END ELSE '완료' END AS status FROM INSPECTION_ITEM_RESULTS iir JOIN CHECKLIST_ITEMS ci ON ci.ITEM_ID = iir.ITEM_ID JOIN INSPECTIONS i ON i.INSPECTION_ID = iir.INSPECTION_ID JOIN FACILITIES f ON f.FACILITY_ID = i.FACILITY_ID WHERE iir.INSPECTION_ID = #{inspectionId} AND f.MANAGERS_ID = #{managerId} ORDER BY ci.ORDER_NO NULLS LAST, ci.ITEM_ID
SELECT '/mobile/file/' || image_id AS url FROM images WHERE result_id = #{resultId} ORDER BY image_id
